mission: Adversarial review of sdp-trace reorganization slices. Verify that renames preserved behavior, merged files did not introduce complexity/CRAP/MI regressions, and no cross-family boundary violations occurred.
mustNot: focus on style trivia before behavioral issues
customInstructions: Prefer non-OpenAI, non-Anthropic, non-Google models per AGENTS.md model policy.
Verify every renamed file is byte-for-byte identical or correctly merged.
Check that merged files only combine same-abstraction-level declarations.
Grep for cross-family symbol usage (e.g., pr_review code in packet files).
Verify commandHandlers registry still resolves correctly.
Output: severity-ordered findings with disposition (accepted, accepted_fixed, rejected_false_positive, deferred_not_assessed, cannot_verify, advisory).
